related.title: WebAssembly LEB128：變長整數與位元邊界
related.titleEn: WebAssembly LEB128: variable-length integers and bit boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付bounds-matrix.csv及trap反例；不把Wasm隔離當外部host API必然安全。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver bounds-matrix.csv and trap counterexamples; Wasm isolation does not automatically secure host APIs. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 逐byte移除high bit，左移7k再OR；反向重新編碼核對byte序列。
related.differenceEn: Remove each high bit, shift payload by7k and OR, then re-encode to check the byte sequence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
線性記憶體有明確位元組界限；load/store需整段在範圍內，越界會trap而非自動延伸。
本課數值核對：65532+4 = 65536 end_address；另一項核對：65533+4-65536 = 1 overflow_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

LEB128每byte提供七個payload bits與continuation bit；signed與unsigned解碼不能混用，還需限制位元寬度。
本課數值核對：101+14*128+38*16384 = 624485 value；另一項核對：ceil(32/7) = 5 max_bytes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Linear memory has explicit byte bounds; an entire load/store must lie inside, and out-of-bounds access traps rather than extending memory.
Numeric audit: 65532+4 = 65536 end_address; second audit: 65533+4-65536 = 1 overflow_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

LEB128 provides seven payload bits plus a continuation bit per byte; signed and unsigned forms differ and require width limits.
Numeric audit: 101+14*128+38*16384 = 624485 value; second audit: ceil(32/7) = 5 max_bytes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 逐輪列ready queue與各節點indegree；合法序可A B C D或B A C D，不硬訂唯一答案。
related.differenceEn: Trace ready queues and indegrees; either A B C D or B A C D is legal, so do not require one unique order.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

入度為零的節點才可從DAG移出；有剩餘節點代表循環或受循環阻擋，不代表剩下全部都在同一cycle。
本課數值核對：max(2,3)+4+1 = 8 s；另一項核對：2+3+4+1 = 10 s。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

Only zero-indegree nodes can be removed; residual nodes are cyclic or blocked by cycles, not necessarily all members of one cycle.
